text.en: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

text.am: በምሳሌም ብዙ ነገራቸው እንዲህም አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ዘሪ ሊዘራ ወጣ።
text.en: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

text.am: እርሱም ሲዘራ አንዳንዱ በመንገድ ዳር ወደቀ፥ ወፎችም መጥተው በሉት።
text.en: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

text.am: ሌላውም ብዙ መሬት በሌለበት በጭንጫ ላይ ወደቀ፤ ጥልቅ መሬትም ስላልነበረው ወዲያው በቀለ፥
text.en: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:

text.am: ፀሐይ በወጣ ጊዜ ግን ጠወለገ፥ ሥርም ስላልነበረው ደረቀ።
text.en: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

text.am: ሌላውም በእሾህ መካከል ወደቀ፥ እሾህም ወጣና አነቀው።
text.en: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:

text.am: ሌላውም በመልካም መሬት ወደቀ፤ አንዱም መቶ፥ አንዱም ስድሳ፥ አንዱም ሠላሳ ፍሬ ሰጠ።
text.en: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

text.am: የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ ።
text.en: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ቀርበው። ስለ ምን በምሳሌ ትነግራቸዋለህ? አሉት።
text.en: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?

text.am: እርሱም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ለእናንተ የ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ን ምሥጢር ማወቅ ተሰጥቶአችኋል፥ ለእነርሱ ግን አልተሰጣቸውም።
text.en: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

text.am: ላለው ይሰጠዋልና ይበዛለትማል፤ ከሌለው ግን ያው ያለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።
text.en: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.

text.am: ስለዚህ እያዩ ስለማያዩ እየሰሙም ስለማይሰሙ ስለማያስተውሉም በምሳሌ እነግራቸዋለሁ።
text.en: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.

text.am: መስማት ትሰማላችሁና አታስተውሉም፥ ማየትም ታያላችሁና አትመለከቱም።
text.en: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:

text.am: በዓይናቸው እንዳያዩ፥ በጆሮአቸውም እንዳይሰሙ ፥ በልባቸውም እንዳያስተውሉ፥ ተመልሰውም እንዳልፈውሳቸው፥ የዚህ ሕዝብ ልብ ደንድኖአልና ጆሮአቸውም ደንቁሮአል ዓይናቸውንም ጨፍነዋል የሚል የኢሳይያስ ትንቢት በእነርሱ ይፈጸማል።
text.en: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

text.am: የእናንተ ግን ዓይኖቻችሁ ስለሚያዩ ጆሮቻችሁም ስለሚሰሙ ብፁዓን ናቸው።
text.en: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

text.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ብዙዎች ነቢያትና ጻድቃን የምታዩትን ሊያዩ ተመኝተው አላዩም፥ የምትሰሙትንም ሊሰሙ ተመኝተው አልሰሙም።
text.en: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

text.am: እንግዲህ እናንተ የዘሪውን ምሳሌ ስሙ ።
text.en: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.

text.am: የመንግሥትን ቃል ሰምቶ በማያስተውል ሁሉ፥ ክፉው ይመጣል፥ በልቡ የተዘራውንም ይነጥቃል፤ በመንገድ ዳር የተዘራው ይህ ነው።
text.en: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

text.am: በጭንጫ ላይ የተዘራውም ይህ ቃሉን ሰምቶ ወዲያው በደስታ የሚቀበለው ነው፤
text.en: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;

text.am: ነገር ግን ለጊዜው ነው እንጂ በእርሱ ሥር የለውም፥ በቃሉ ምክንያትም መከራ ወይም ስደት በሆነ ጊዜ ወዲያው ይሰናከላል።
text.en: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.

text.am: በእሾህ መካከል የተዘራውም ይህ ቃሉን የሚሰማ ነው፥ የዚህም ዓለም አሳብና የባለጠግነት መታለል ቃሉን ያንቃል፥ የማያፈራም ይሆናል።
text.en: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

text.am: በመልካም መሬት የተዘራውም ይህ ቃሉን ሰምቶ የሚያስተውል ነው፤ እርሱም ፍሬ ያፈራል አንዱም መቶ አንዱም ስድሳ አንዱም ሠላሳ ያደርጋል።
text.en: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

text.am: ሌላ ምሳሌ አቀረበላቸው እንዲህም አለ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት በእርሻው መልካም ዘርን የዘራን ሰው ትመስላለች ።
text.en: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:

text.am: ሰዎቹ ሲተኙ ግን ጠላቱ መጣና በስንዴው መካከል እንክርዳድን ዘርቶ ሄደ።
text.en: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.

text.am: ስንዴውም በበቀለና በአፈራ ጊዜ እንክርዳዱ ደግሞ ያን ጊዜ ታየ።
text.en: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

text.am: የባለቤቱም ባሮች ቀርበው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ መልካምን ዘር በእርሻህ ዘርተህ አልነበርህምን? እንክርዳዱንስ ከወዴት አገኘ? አሉት።
text.en: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?

text.am: እርሱም። ጠላት ይህን አደረገ አላቸው። ባሮቹም። እንግዲህ ሄደን ብንለቅመው ትወዳለህን? አሉት።
text.en: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?

text.am: እርሱ ግን። እንክርዳዱን ስትለቅሙ ስንዴውን ከእርሱ ጋር እንዳትነቅሉት አይሆንም።
text.en: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.

text.am: ተዉአቸው፤ እስከ መከር ጊዜ አብረው ይደጉ፤ በመከር ጊዜም አጫጆችን። እንክርዳዱን አስቀድማችሁ ልቀሙ በእሳትም ለማቃጠል በየነዶው እሰሩ፥ ስንዴውን ግን በጎተራዬ ክተቱ እላለሁ አለ።
text.en: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.

text.am: ሌላ ምሳሌ አቀረበላቸው እንዲህም አለ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ሰው ወስዶ በእርሻው የዘራትን የሰናፍጭ ቅንጣት ትመስላለች ፤
text.en: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

text.am: እርስዋም ከዘር ሁሉ ታንሳለች፥ በአደገች ጊዜ ግን፥ ከአታክልቶች ትበልጣለች የሰማይም ወፎች መጥተው በቅርንጫፎችዋ እስኪሰፍሩ ድረስ ዛፍ ትሆናለች።
text.en: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.

text.am: ሌላ ምሳሌ ነገራቸው እንዲህም አለ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ሁሉ እስኪቦካ ድረስ ሴት ወስዳ በሦስት መስፈሪያ ዱቄት የሸሸገችውን እርሾ ትመስላለች ።
text.en: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ለሕዝቡ ይህን ሁሉ በምሳሌ ተናገረ፤ በነቢዩም። በምሳሌ አፌን እከፍታለሁ፥ ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ የተሰወረውንም እናገራለሁ የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ያለ ምሳሌ አልተናገራቸውም።
text.en: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:

text.am: ኢየሱስም ለሕዝቡ ይህን ሁሉ በምሳሌ ተናገረ፤ በነቢዩም። በምሳሌ አፌን እከፍታለሁ፥ ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ የተሰወረውንም እናገራለሁ የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ያለ ምሳሌ አልተናገራቸውም።
text.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ሕዝቡን ትቶ ወደ ቤት ገባ። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። የእርሻውን እንክርዳድ ምሳሌ ተርጕምልን አሉት።
text.en: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.

text.am: እርሱም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። መልካምን ዘር የዘራው የሰው ልጅ ነው፤ እርሻውም ዓለም ነው፤
text.en: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;

text.am: መልካሙም ዘር የመንግሥት ልጆች ናቸው፤
text.en: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;

text.am: እንክርዳዱም የክፉው ልጆች ናቸው፥ የዘራውም ጠላት ዲያብሎስ ነው፤ መከሩም የዓለም መጨረሻ ነው፥ አጫጆችም መላእክት ናቸው።
text.en: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

text.am: እንግዲህ እንክርዳድ ተለቅሞ በእሳት እንደሚቃጠል፥ በዓለም መጨረሻ እንዲሁ ይሆናል።
text.en: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

text.am: የሰው ልጅ መላእክቱን ይልካል፥ ከመንግሥቱም እንቅፋትን ሁሉ ዓመፃንም የሚያደርጉትን ይለቅማሉ፥
text.en: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;

text.am: ወደ እቶነ እሳትም ይጥሉአቸዋል፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።
text.en: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጻድቃን በአባታቸው መንግሥት እንደ ፀሐይ ይበራሉ። የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ ።
text.en: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

text.am: ደግሞ መንግሥተ ሰማያት በእርሻ ውስጥ የተሰወረውን መዝገብ ትመስላለች ፤ ሰውም አግኝቶ ሰወረው፥ ከደስታውም የተነሣ ሄዶ ያለውን ሁሉ ሸጠና ያን እርሻ ገዛ።
text.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

text.am: ደግሞ መንግሥተ ሰማያት መልካምን ዕንቁ የሚሻ ነጋዴን ትመስላለች ፤
text.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

text.am: ዋጋዋም እጅግ የበዛ አንዲት ዕንቁ በአገኘ ጊዜ ሄዶ ያለውን ሁሉ ሸጠና ገዛት።
text.en: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

text.am: ደግሞ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ወደ ባሕር የተጣለች ከሁሉም ዓይነት የሰበሰበች መረብን ትመስላለች ፤
text.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

text.am: በሞላችም ጊዜ ወደ ወደቡ አወጡአት፥ ተቀምጠውም መልካሙን ለቅመው በዕቃዎች ውስጥ አከማቹ ክፉውን ግን ወደ ውጭ ጣሉት።
text.en: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.

text.am: በዓለም መጨረሻ እንዲሁ ይሆናል፤ መላእክት መጥተው ኃጢአተኞችን ከጻድቃን መካከል ይለዩአቸዋል፥ ወደ እቶነ እሳትም ይጥሉአቸዋል፤
text.en: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

text.am: በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።
text.en: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

text.am: ኢየሱስም። ይህን ሁሉ አስተዋላችሁን? አላቸው አዎን አሉት።
text.en: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.

text.am: እርሱም። ስለዚህ የ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ደቀ መዝሙር የሆነ ጻፊ ሁሉ ከመዝገቡ አዲሱንና አሮጌውን የሚያወጣ ባለቤትን ይመስላል አላቸው።
text.en: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.

text.am: ኢየሱስም እነዚህም ምሳሌዎች ከጨረሰ በኋላ ከዚያ ሄደ።
text.en: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.

text.am: ወደ ገዛ አገሩም መጥቶ እስኪገረሙ ድረስ በምኩራባቸው ያስተምራቸው ነበር፤ እንዲህም አሉ። ይህን ጥበብና ተአምራት ይህ ከወዴት አገኘው?
text.en: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?

text.am: ይህ የጸራቢ ልጅ አይደለምን? እናቱስ ማርያም ትባል የለምን? ወንድሞቹስ ያዕቆብና ዮሳ ስምዖንም ይሁዳም አይደሉምን?
text.en: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

text.am: እኅቶቹስ ሁሉ በእኛ ዘንድ ያሉ አይደሉምን? እንኪያስ ይህን ሁሉ ከወዴት አገኘው? ተሰናከሉበትም።
text.en: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

text.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። ነቢይ ከገዛ አገሩና ከገዛ ቤቱ በቀር ሳይከበር አይቀርም አላቸው።
text.en: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.

text.am: በአለማመናቸውም ምክንያት በዚያ ብዙ ተአምራት አላደረገም።
text.en: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

text.am: በዚያ ዘመን የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ ሄሮድስ የኢየሱስን ዝና ሰማ፥
text.en: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,

text.am: ለሎሌዎቹም። ይህ መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ ነው፤ እርሱ ከሙታን ተነሥቶአል፥ ስለዚህም ኃይል በእርሱ ይደረጋል አለ።
text.en: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

text.am: ሄሮድስ በወንድሙ በፊልጶስ ሚስት በሄሮድያዳ ምክንያት ዮሐንስን አስይዞ አሳስሮት በወህኒ አኑሮት ነበርና፤
text.en: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.

text.am: ዮሐንስ። እርስዋ ለአንተ ትሆን ዘንድ አልተፈቀደም ይለው ነበርና።
text.en: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.

text.am: ሊገድለውም ወዶ ሳለ፥ ሕዝቡ እንደ ነቢይ ስለ አዩት ፈራቸው።
text.en: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

text.am: ነገር ግን ሄሮድስ የተወለደበት ቀን በሆነ ጊዜ፥ የሄሮድያዳ ልጅ በመካከላቸው ዘፈነች ሄሮድስንም ደስ አሰኘችው፤
text.en: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.

text.am: ስለዚህም የምትለምነውን ሁሉ እንዲሰጣት በመሐላ ተስፋ አደረገላት።
text.en: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.

text.am: እርስዋም በእናትዋ ተመክራ። የመጥምቁን የዮሐንስን ራስ በዚህ በወጭት ስጠኝ አለችው።
text.en: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.

text.am: ንጉሡም አዘነ፥ ነገር ግን ስለ መሐላው ከእርሱም ጋር ተቀምጠው ስላሉት ሰዎች እንዲሰጡአት አዘዘ፤
text.en: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.

text.am: ልኮም የዮሐንስን ራስ በወህኒ አስቆረጠው።
text.en: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

text.am: ራሱንም በወጭት አምጥተው ለብላቴናይቱ ሰጡአት፥ ወደ እናትዋም ወሰደችው።
text.en: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ቀርበው በድኑን ወሰዱና ቀበሩት፥ መጥተውም ለኢየሱስ አወሩለት።
text.en: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.

text.am: ኢየሱስም በሰማ ጊዜ ከዚያ ብቻውን ወደ ምድረ በዳ በታንኳ ፈቀቅ አለ፤ ሕዝቡም ሰምተው ከከተማዎቹ በእግር ተከተሉት።
text.en: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.

text.am: ወጥቶም ብዙ ሕዝብ አየና አዘነላቸው ድውዮቻቸውንም ፈወሰ።
text.en: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.

text.am: በመሸም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። ቦታው ምድረ በዳ ነው አሁንም ሰዓቱ አልፎአል፤ ወደ መንደሮች ሄደው ለራሳቸው ምግብ እንዲገዙ ሕዝቡን አሰናብት አሉት።
text.en: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.

text.am: ኢየሱስም። እናንተ የሚበሉትን ስጡአቸው እንጂ ሊሄዱ አያስፈልግም አላቸው።
text.en: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.

text.am: እነርሱም። ከአምስት እንጀራና ከሁለት ዓሣ በቀር በዚህ የለንም አሉት።
text.en: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

text.am: እርሱም። እነዚያን ወደዚህ አምጡልኝ አላቸው።
text.en: He said, Bring them hither to me.

text.am: ሕዝቡም በሣር ላይ እንዲቀመጡ አዘዘ፥ አምስቱንም እንጀራና ሁለቱን ዓሣ ይዞ ወደ ሰማይ አሻቅቦ አየና ባረከ፥ እንጀራውንም ቆርሶ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለሕዝቡ።
text.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

text.am: ሁሉም በልተው ጠገቡ፥ የተረፈውንም ቁርስራሽ አሥራ ሁለት መሶብ ሙሉ አነሡ።
text.en: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

text.am: ከሴቶችና ከልጆችም በቀር የበሉት አምስት ሺህ ወንዶች ያህሉ ነበር።
text.en: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.

text.am: ወዲያውም ሕዝቡን ሲያሰናብት ሳለ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ በታንኳይቱ ገብተው ወደ ማዶ እንዲቀድሙት ግድ አላቸው።
text.en: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

text.am: ሕዝቡንም አሰናብቶ ይጸልይ ዘንድ ብቻውን ወደ ተራራ ወጣ። በመሸም ጊዜ ብቻውን በዚያ ነበረ።
text.en: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

text.am: ታንኳይቱም አሁን በባሕር መካከል ሳለች፥ ነፋስ ከወደ ፊት ነበርና በማዕበል ትጨነቅ ነበር።
text.en: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

text.am: ከሌሊቱም በአራተኛው ክፍል ኢየሱስ በባሕር ላይ እየሄደ ወደ እነርሱ መጣ።
text.en: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም በባሕር ላይ ሲሄድ ባዩት ጊዜ። ምትሐት ነው ብለው ታወኩ በፍርሃትም ጮኹ።
text.en: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.

text.am: ወዲያውም ኢየሱስ ተናገራቸውና። አይዞአችሁ፥ እኔ ነኝ፤ አትፍሩ አላቸው።
text.en: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

text.am: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተስ ከሆንህ በውኃው ላይ ወደ አንተ እንድመጣ እዘዘኝ አለው።
text.en: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.

text.am: እርሱም። ና አለው። ጴጥሮስም ከታንኳይቱ ወርዶ ወደ ኢየሱስ ሊደርስ በውኃው ላይ ሄደ።
text.en: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

text.am: ነገር ግን የነፋሱን ኃይል አይቶ ፈራ፥ ሊሰጥምም በጀመረ ጊዜ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አድነኝ ብሎ ጮኸ።
text.en: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

text.am: ወዲያውም ኢየሱስ እጁን ዘርግቶ ያዘውና። አንተ እምነት የጎደለህ፥ ስለምን ተጠራጠርህ? አለው።
text.en: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

text.am: ወደ ታንኳይቱም በወጡ ጊዜ ነፋሱ ተወ።
text.en: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.

text.am: በታንኳይቱም የነበሩት። በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ ብለው ሰገዱለት።
text.en: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.

text.am: ተሻግረውም ወደ ጌንሴሬጥ ምድር መጡ።
text.en: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.

text.am: የዚያ ቦታ ሰዎችም ባወቁት ጊዜ በዙርያው ወዳለ አገር ሁሉ ላኩ፥ ሕመምተኞችንም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤
text.en: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;

text.am: የልብሱንም ጫፍ ብቻ ሊዳስሱ ይለምኑት ነበር፤ የዳሰሱትም ሁሉ ዳኑ።
text.en: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀረቡና።
text.en: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርትህ ስለ ምን የሽማግሎችን ወግ ይተላለፋሉ? እንጀራ ሲበሉ እጃቸውን አይታጠቡምና አሉት።
text.en: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.

text.am: እርሱም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። እናንተስ ስለ ወጋችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ስለ ምን ትተላለፋላችሁ?
text.en: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?

text.am: እግዚአብሔር። አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ ደግሞ። አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሰደበ ፈጽሞ ይሙት ብሎአልና፤
text.en: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.

text.am: እናንተ ግን። አባቱን ወይም እናቱን። ከእኔ የምትጠቀምበት መባ ነው የሚል ሁሉ፥
text.en: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;

text.am: አባቱን ወይም እናቱን አያከብርም ትላላችሁ፤ ስለ ወጋችሁም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሻራችሁ።
text.en: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.

text.am: እናንተ ግብዞች፥ ኢሳይያስ ስለ እናንተ።
text.en: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

text.am: ይህ ሕዝብ በከንፈሩ ያከብረኛል፥ ልቡ ግን ከእኔ በጣም የራቀ ነው፤
text.en: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

text.am: የሰውም ሥርዓት የሆነ ትምህርት እያስተማሩ በከንቱ ያመልኩኛል ብሎ በእውነት ትንቢት ተናገረ።
text.en: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

text.am: ሕዝቡንም ጠርቶ። ስሙ አስተውሉም፤
text.en: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

text.am: ሰውን የሚያረክሰው ወደ አፍ የሚገባ አይደለም፥ ከአፍ የሚወጣው ግን ሰውን የሚያረክሰው ይህ ነው አላቸው።
text.en: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ቀርበው። ፈሪሳውያን ይህን ቃል ሰምተው እንደ ተሰናከሉ አወቅህን? አሉት።
text.en: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?

text.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። የሰማዩ አባቴ ያልተከለው ተክል ሁሉ ይነቀላል።
text.en: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.

text.am: ተዉአቸው፤ ዕውሮችን የሚመሩ ዕውሮች ናቸው፤ ዕውርም ዕውርን ቢመራው ሁለቱም ወደ ጉድጓድ ይወድቃሉ አለ።
text.en: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

text.am: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። ምሳሌውን ተርጕምልን አለው።
text.en: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.

text.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አለ። እናንተ ደግሞ እስካሁን የማታስተውሉ ናችሁን?
text.en: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?

text.am: ወደ አፍ የሚገባ ሁሉ ወደ ሆድ አልፎ ወደ እዳሪ እንዲጣል አትመለከቱምን?
text.en: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

text.am: ከአፍ የሚወጣ ግን ከልብ ይወጣል፥ ሰውንም የሚያረክሰው ያ ነው።
text.en: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.

text.am: ከልብ ክፉ አሳብ፥ መግደል፥ ምንዝርነት፥ ዝሙት፥ መስረቅ፥ በውሸት መመስከር፥ ስድብ ይወጣልና።
text.en: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

text.am: ሰውን የሚያረክሰው ይህ ነው እንጂ፥ ባልታጠበ እጅ መብላትስ ሰውን አያረክሰውም።
text.en: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ ወጥቶ ወደ ጢሮስና ወደ ሲዶና አገር ሄደ።
text.en: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

text.am: እነሆም፥ ከነናዊት ሴት ከዚያ አገር ወጥታ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ማረኝ፤ ልጄን ጋኔን ክፉኛ ይዞአታል ብላ ጮኸች።
text.en: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

text.am: እርሱ ግን አንዳች አልመለሰላትም። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ቀርበው። በኋላችን ትጮኻለችና አሰናብታት እያሉ ለመኑት።
text.en: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.

text.am: እርሱም መልሶ። ከእስራኤል ቤት ለጠፉት በጎች በቀር አልተላክሁም አለ።
text.en: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

text.am: እርስዋ ግን መጥታ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እርዳኝ እያለች ሰገደችለት።
text.en: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

text.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። የልጆችን እንጀራ ይዞ ለቡችሎች መጣል አይገባም አለ።
text.en: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.

text.am: እርስዋም። አዎን ጌታ ሆይ፤ ቡችሎችም እኮ ከጌቶቻቸው ማዕድ የወደቀውን ፍርፋሪ ይበላሉ አለች።
text.en: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ መልሶ። አንቺ ሴት፥ እምነትሽ ታላቅ ነው፤ እንደወደድሽ ይሁንልሽ አላት። ልጅዋም ከዚያች ሰዓት ጀምሮ ዳነች።
text.en: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ አልፎ ወደ ገሊላ ባሕር አጠገብ መጣ፥ ወደ ተራራም ወጥቶ በዚያ ተቀመጠ።
text.en: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.

text.am: ብዙ ሕዝብም አንካሶችን፥ ዕውሮችንም፥ ዲዳዎችንም፥ ጉንድሾችንም፥ ሌሎችንም ብዙ ይዘው ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፥ በኢየሱስም እግር አጠገብ ጣሉአቸው፤ ፈወሳቸውም፤
text.en: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:

text.am: ስለዚህም ሕዝቡ ዲዳዎች ሲናገሩ፥ ጉንድሾችም ሲድኑ፥ አንካሶችም ሲሄዱ፥ ዕውሮችም ሲያዩ አይተው ተደነቁ፤ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ አከበሩ።
text.en: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ጠርቶ። ሕዝቡ ከእኔ ጋር እስካሁን ሦስት ቀን ውለዋልና የሚበሉት ስለ ሌላቸው አዝንላቸዋለሁ፤ በመንገድም እንዳይዝሉ ጦማቸውን ላሰናብታቸው አልወድም አላቸው።
text.en: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። ይህን ያህል ሕዝብ የሚያጠግብ ይህን ያህል እንጀራ በምድረ በዳ ከወዴት እናገኛለን? አሉት።
text.en: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?

text.am: ኢየሱስም። ስንት እንጀራ አላችሁ? አላቸው። እነርሱም። ሰባት፥ ጥቂትም ትንሽ ዓሣ አሉት።
text.en: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.

text.am: ሕዝቡም በምድር ላይ እንዲቀመጡ አዘዘ፤
text.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

text.am: ሰባቱንም እንጀራ ዓሣውንም ይዞ አመሰገነ ቈርሶም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለሕዝቡ።
text.en: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

text.am: ሁሉም በሉና ጠገቡ፥ የተረፈውንም ቁርስራሽ ሰባት ቅርጫት ሙሉ አነሡ።
text.en: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.

text.am: የበሉትም ከሴቶችና ከልጆች በቀር አራት ሺህ ወንዶች ነበሩ።
text.en: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.

text.am: ሕዝቡንም ካሰናበተ በኋላ ወደ ታንኳይቱ ገብቶ ወደ መጌዶል አገር መጣ።
text.en: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.

text.am: ፈሪሳውያንና ሰዱቃውያንም ቀርበው ሲፈትኑት ከሰማይ ምልክት እንዲያሳያቸው ለመኑት።
text.en: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.

text.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። በመሸ ጊዜ። ሰማዩ ቀልቶአልና ብራ ይሆናል ትላላችሁ፤
text.en: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.

text.am: ማለዳም። ሰማዩ ደምኖ ቀልቶአልና ዛሬ ይዘንባል ትላላችሁ። የሰማዩን ፊትማ መለየት ታውቃላችሁ፥ የዘመኑንስ ምልክት መለየት አትችሉምን?
text.en: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?

text.am: ክፉና አመንዝራ ትውልድ ምልክት ይሻል፥ ከነቢዩም ከዮናስ ምልክት በቀር ምልክት አይሰጠውም። ትቶአቸውም ሄደ።
text.en: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ ማዶ በመጡ ጊዜ እንጀራ መያዝን ረሱ።
text.en: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

text.am: ኢየሱስም። ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያን እርሾ ተጠንቀቁና ተጠበቁ አላቸው።
text.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

text.am: እነርሱም። እንጀራ ባንይዝ ነው ብለው እርስ በርሳቸው ተነጋገሩ።
text.en: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.

text.am: ኢየሱስም አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። እናንተ እምነት የጐደላችሁ፥ እንጀራ ስለ ሌላችሁ ስለ ምን እርስ በርሳችሁ ትነጋገራላችሁ? ገና አታስተውሉምን?
text.en: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?

text.am: ለአምስቱ ሺህ አምስቱ እንጀራ፥ ስንት መሶብም እንዳነሣችሁ ትዝ አይላችሁምን?
text.en: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

text.am: ወይስ ለአራቱ ሺህ ሰባቱ እንጀራ፥ ስንት ቅርጫትም እንዳነሣችሁ ትዝ አይላችሁምን?
text.en: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

text.am: ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያን እርሾ እንድትጠበቁ ብዬ ስለ እንጀራ እንዳልተናገርኋችሁ እንዴት አታስተውሉምን?
text.en: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

text.am: እነርሱም ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያን ትምህርት እንጂ ከእንጀራ እርሾ እንዲጠበቁ እንዳላላቸው ያን ጊዜ አስተዋሉ።
text.en: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ ፊልጶስ ቂሣርያ አገር በደረሰ ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። ሰዎች የሰውን ልጅ ማን እንደ ሆነ ይሉታል? ብሎ ጠየቀ።
text.en: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

text.am: እነርሱም። አንዳንዱ መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ፥ ሌሎችም ኤልያስ፥ ሌሎችም ኤርምያስ ወይም ከነቢያት አንዱ ነው ይላሉ አሉት።
text.en: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

text.am: እርሱም። እናንተስ እኔን ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ትላላችሁ? አላቸው።
text.en: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?

text.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። አንተ ክርስቶስ የሕያው እግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ አለ።
text.en: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

text.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው። የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ሆይ፥ በሰማያት ያለው አባቴ እንጂ ሥጋና ደም ይህን አልገለጠልህምና ብፁዕ ነህ።
text.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

text.am: እኔም እልሃለሁ፥ አንተ ጴጥሮስ ነህ፥ በዚችም ዓለት ላይ ቤተ ክርስቲያኔን እሠራለሁ፥ የገሃነም ደጆችም አይችሉአትም።
text.en: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

text.am: የመንግሥተ ሰማያትንም መክፈቻዎች እሰጥሃለሁ፤ በምድር የምታስረው ሁሉ በሰማያት የታሰረ ይሆናል፥ በምድርም የምትፈታው ሁሉ በሰማያት የተፈታ ይሆናል።
text.en: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

text.am: ያን ጊዜም እርሱ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ ለማንም እንዳይነግሩ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን አዘዛቸው።
text.en: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

text.am: ከዚያን ቀን ጀምሮ ኢየሱስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይሄድ ዘንድ ከሽማግሎችና ከካህናት አለቆች ከጻፎችም ብዙ መከራ ይቀበልና ይገደል ዘንድ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣ ዘንድ እንዲገባው ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ይገልጥላቸው ጀመር።
text.en: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

text.am: ጴጥሮስም ወደ እርሱ ወስዶ። አይሁንብህ ጌታ ሆይ፤ ይህ ከቶ አይደርስብህም ብሎ ሊገሥጸው ጀመረ።
text.en: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

text.am: እርሱ ግን ዘወር ብሎ ጴጥሮስን። ወደ ኋላዬ ሂድ፥ አንተ ሰይጣን፤ የሰውን እንጂ የእግዚአብሔርን አታስብምና ዕንቅፋት ሆነህብኛል አለው።
text.en: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንዲህ አለ። እኔን መከተል የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ ራሱን ይካድ መስቀሉንም ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ።
text.en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

text.am: ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚወድ ሁሉ ያጠፋታል፤ ስለ እኔ ግን ነፍሱን የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ ያገኛታል።
text.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

text.am: ሰው ዓለሙን ሁሉ ቢያተርፍ ነፍሱንም ቢያጐድል ምን ይጠቅመዋል? ወይስ ሰው ስለ ነፍሱ ቤዛ ምን ይሰጣል?
text.en: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

text.am: የሰው ልጅ ከመላእክቱ ጋር በአባቱ ክብር ይመጣ ዘንድ አለውና፤ ያን ጊዜም ለሁሉ እንደ ሥራው ያስረክበዋል።
text.en: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

text.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የሰው ልጅ በመንግሥቱ ሲመጣ እስኪያዩ ድረስ እዚህ ከሚቆሙት ሞትን የማይቀምሱ አንዳንድ አሉ።
text.en: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

text.am: ከስድስት ቀንም በኋላ ኢየሱስ ጴጥሮስንና ያዕቆብን ወንድሙንም ዮሐንስን ይዞ ወደ ረጅም ተራራ ብቻቸውን አወጣቸው።
text.en: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,

text.am: በፊታቸውም ተለወጠ፥ ፊቱም እንደ ፀሐይ በራ፥ ልብሱም እንደ ብርሃን ነጭ ሆነ።
text.en: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

text.am: እነሆም፥ ሙሴና ኤልያስ ከእርሱ ጋር ሲነጋገሩ ታዩአቸው።
text.en: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

text.am: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ ኢየሱስን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በዚህ መሆን ለእኛ መልካም ነው፤ ብትወድስ፥ በዚህ ሦስት ዳስ አንዱን ለአንተ አንዱንም ለሙሴ አንዱንም ለኤልያስ እንሥራ አለ።
text.en: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

text.am: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር፥ እነሆ፥ ብሩህ ደመና ጋረዳቸው፥ እነሆም፥ ከደመናው። በእርሱ ደስ የሚለኝ የምወደው ልጄ ይህ ነው፤ እርሱን ስሙት የሚል ድምፅ መጣ።
text.en: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሰምተው በፊታቸው ወደቁ እጅግም ፈርተው ነበር።
text.en: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ቀርቦ ዳሰሳቸውና። ተነሡ አትፍሩም አላቸው።
text.en: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

text.am: ዓይናቸውንም አቅንተው ሲያዩ ከኢየሱስ ብቻ በቀር ማንንም አላዩም።
text.en: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

text.am: ከተራራውም በወረዱ ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። የሰው ልጅ ከሙታን እስኪነሣ ድረስ ያያችሁትን ለማንም አትንገሩ ብሎ አዘዛቸው።
text.en: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። እንግዲህ ጻፎች። ኤልያስ አስቀድሞ ሊመጣ ይገባዋል ስለ ምን ይላሉ? ብለው ጠየቁት።
text.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?

text.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ኤልያስማ አስቀድሞ ይመጣል ሁሉንም ያቀናል፤
text.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

text.am: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ኤልያስ ከዚህ በፊት መጣ፤ የወደዱትንም ሁሉ አደረጉበት እንጂ አላወቁትም፤ እንዲሁም ደግሞ የሰው ልጅ ከእነርሱ መከራ ይቀበል ዘንድ አለው አላቸው።
text.en: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ስለ መጥምቁ ስለ ዮሐንስ እንደ ነገራቸው አስተዋሉ።
text.en: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.

text.am: ወደ ሕዝቡም ሲደርሱ አንድ ሰው ወደ እርሱ ቀረበና ተንበርክኮ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ልጄን ማርልኝ፥ በጨረቃ እየተነሣበት ክፉኛ ይሣቀያልና፤
text.en: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

text.am: ብዙ ጊዜ በእሳት ብዙ ጊዜም በውኃ ይወድቃልና።
text.en: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

text.am: ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርትህም አመጣሁት ሊፈውሱትም አቃታቸው አለው።
text.en: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

text.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። የማታምን ጠማማ ትውልድ ሆይ፥ እስከ መቼ ከእናንተ ጋር እኖራለሁ? እስከ መቼስ እታገሣችኋለሁ? ወደዚህ ወደ እኔ አምጡት አለ።
text.en: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ገሠጸው ጋኔኑም ከእርሱ ወጣ፥ ብላቴናውም ከዚያች ሰዓት ጀምሮ ተፈወሰ።
text.en: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

text.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ብቻቸውን ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀረቡና። እኛ ልናወጣው ያልቻልን ስለ ምን ነው? አሉት።
text.en: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

text.am: ኢየሱስም። ስለ እምነታችሁ ማነስ ነው፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የሰናፍጭ ቅንጣት የሚያህል እምነት ቢኖራችሁ፥ ይህን ተራራ። ከዚህ ወደዚያ እለፍ ብትሉት ያልፋል፤ የሚሳናችሁም ነገር የለም።
text.en: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

text.am: ይህ ዓይነት ግን ከጸሎትና ከጦም በቀር አይወጣም አላቸው።
text.en: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

text.am: በገሊላም ሲመላለሱ ኢየሱስ። የሰው ልጅ በሰዎች እጅ አልፎ ይሰጥ ዘንድ አለው፥ ይገድሉትማል፥
text.en: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

text.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣል አላቸው። እጅግም አዘኑ።
text.en: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

text.am: ወደ ቅፍርናሆምም በመጡ ጊዜ ግብር የሚቀበሉ ሰዎች ወደ ጴጥሮስ ቀረቡና። መምህራችሁ ሁለቱን ዲናር*ፍ1* አይገብርምን? አሉት።
text.en: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

text.am: አዎን ይገብራል አለ። ወደ ቤትም በገባ ጊዜ ኢየሱስ አስቀድሞ። ስምዖን ሆይ፥ ምን ይመስልሃል? የምድር ነገሥታት ቀረጥና ግብር ከማን ይቀበላሉ? ከልጆቻቸውን ወይስ ከእንግዶች? አለው።
text.en: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

text.am: ጴጥሮስም። ከእንግዶች ባለው ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። እንኪያስ ልጆቻቸው ነጻ ናቸው።
text.en: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

text.am: ነገር ግን እንዳናሰናክላቸው፥ ወደ ባሕር ሂድና መቃጥን ጣል፥ መጀመሪያም የሚወጣውን ዓሣ ውሰድና አፉን ስትከፍት እስታቴር*ፍ2* ታገኛለህ፤ ያን ወስደህ ስለ እኔና ስለ አንተ ስጣቸው አለው።
text.en: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.

text.am: በዚያች ሰዓት ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀርበው። በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ከሁሉ የሚበልጥ ማን ይሆን? አሉት።
text.en: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

text.am: ሕፃንም ጠርቶ በመካከላቸው አቆመ
text.en: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,

text.am: እንዲህም አለ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ካልተመለሳችሁ እንደ ሕፃናትም ካልሆናችሁ፥ ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ከቶ አትገቡም።
text.en: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

text.am: እንግዲህ እንደዚህ ሕፃን ራሱን የሚያዋርድ ሁሉ፥ በመንግሥተ ሰማያት የሚበልጥ እርሱ ነው።
text.en: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

text.am: እንደዚህም ያለውን አንድ ሕፃን በስሜ የሚቀበል ሁሉ እኔን ይቀበላል፤
text.en: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

text.am: በእኔም ከሚያምኑ ከነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ አንዱን የሚያሰናክል ሁሉ፥ የወፍጮ ድንጋይ በአንገቱ ታስሮ ወደ ጥልቅ ባሕር መስጠም ይሻለው ነበር።
text.en: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

text.am: ወዮ ለዓለም ስለ ማሰናከያ፤ ማሰናከያ ሳይመጣ አይቀርምና፥ ነገር ግን በእርሱ ጠንቅ ማሰናከያ ለሚመጣበት ለዚያ ሰው ወዮለት።
text.en: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!

text.am: እጅህ ወይም እግርህ ብታሰናክልህ፥ ቈርጠህ ከአንተ ጣላት፤ ሁለት እጅ ወይም ሁለት እግር ኖሮህ ወደ ዘላለም እሳት ከምትጣል ይልቅ አንካሳ ወይም ጉንድሽ ሆነህ ወደ ህይወት መግባት ይሻልሀል።
text.en: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

text.am: ዓይንህ ብታሰናክልህ አውጥተህ ከአንተ ጣላት፤ ሁለት ዓይን ኖሮህ ወደ ገሃነመ እሳት ከምትጣል ይልቅ አንዲት ዓይን ኖራህ ወደ ሕይወት መግባት ይሻልሃል።
text.en: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

text.am: ከነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ አንዱን እንዳትንቁ ተጠንቀቁ፤ መላእክቶቻቸው በሰማያት ዘወትር በሰማያት ያለውን የአባቴን ፊት ያያሉ እላችኋለሁና።
text.en: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

text.am: የሰው ልጅ የጠፋውን ለማዳን መጥቶአልና።
text.en: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.

text.am: ምን ይመስላችኋል? ለአንድ ሰው መቶ በጎች ቢኖሩት ከእነርሱም አንዱ ቢባዝን፥ ዘጠና ዘጠኙን በተራራ ትቶ ሄዶም የባዘነውን አይፈልግምን?
text.en: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

text.am: ቢያገኘውም፥ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ካልባዘኑቱ ከዘጠና ዘጠኙ ይልቅ በእርሱ ደስ ይለዋል።
text.en: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

text.am: እንደዚሁ ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ አንዱ እንዲጠፋ በሰማያት ያለው አባታችሁ ፈቃድ አይደለም።
text.en: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

text.am: ወንድምህም ቢበድልህ፥ ሄደህ አንተና እርሱ ብቻችሁን ሆናችሁ ውቀሰው። ቢሰማህ፥ ወንድምህን ገንዘብ አደረግኸው፤
text.en: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

text.am: ባይሰማህ ግን፥ በሁለት ወይም በሦስት ምስክር አፍ ነገር ሁሉ እንዲጸና፥ ዳግመኛ አንድ ወይም ሁለት ከአንተ ጋር ውሰድ፤
text.en: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

text.am: እነርሱንም ባይሰማ፥ ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ንገራት፤ ደግሞም ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ባይሰማት፥ እንደ አረመኔና እንደ ቀራጭ ይሁንልህ።
text.en: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

text.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በምድር የምታስሩት ሁሉ በሰማይ የታሰረ ይሆናል፥ በምድርም የምትፈቱት ሁሉ በሰማይ የተፈታ ይሆናል።
text.en: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

text.am: ደግሞ እላችኋለሁ፥ ከእናንተ ሁለቱ በምድር በማናቸውም በሚለምኑት ነገር ሁሉ ቢስማሙ በሰማያት ካለው ከአባቴ ዘንድ ይደረግላቸዋል።
text.en: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

text.am: ሁለት ወይም ሦስት በስሜ በሚሰበሰቡበት በዚያ በመካከላቸው እሆናለሁና።
text.en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጴጥሮስ ወደ እርሱ ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወንድሜ ቢበድለኝ ስንት ጊዜ ልተውለት? እስከ ሰባት ጊዜን? አለው።
text.en: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

text.am: ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አለው። እስከ ሰባ ጊዜ ሰባት እንጂ እስከ ሰባት ጊዜ አልልህም።
text.en: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

text.am: ስለዚህ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ባሮቹን ሊቈጣጠር የወደደን ንጉሥ ትመስላለች።
text.en: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.

text.am: መቈጣጠርም በጀመረ ጊዜ፥ እልፍ መክሊት ዕዳ ያለበትን አንድ ሰው ወደ እርሱ አመጡ።
text.en: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

text.am: የሚከፍለውም ቢያጣ፥ እርሱና ሚስቱ ልጆቹም ያለውም ሁሉ እንዲሸጥና ዕዳው እንዲከፈል ጌታው አዘዘ።
text.en: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

text.am: ስለዚህ ባሪያው ወድቆ ሰገደለትና። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ታገሠኝ፥ ሁሉንም እከፍልሃለሁ አለው።
text.en: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

text.am: የዚያም ባሪያ ጌታ አዘነለትና ለቀቀው፥ ዕዳውንም ተወለት።
text.en: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.

text.am: ነገር ግን ያ ባሪያ ወጥቶ ከባልንጀሮቹ ከባሮቹ መቶ ዲናር ዕዳ ያለበትን አንዱን አገኘና። ዕዳህን ክፈለኝ ብሎ ያዘና አነቀው።
text.en: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

text.am: ስለዚህ ባልንጀራው ባሪያ ወድቆ። ታገሠኝ፥ ሁሉንም እከፍልሃለሁ ብሎ ለመነው።
text.en: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

text.am: እርሱም አልወደደም፥ ግን ሄዶ ዕዳውን እስኪከፍል ድረስ በወኅኒ አኖረው።
text.en: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

text.am: ባልንጀሮቹ የሆኑ ባሮችም ያደረገውን አይተው እጅግ አዘኑ፥ መጥተውም የሆነውን ሁሉ ለጌታቸው ገለጡ።
text.en: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

text.am: ከዚያ ወዲያ ጌታው ጠርቶ። አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ፥ ስለ ለመንኸኝ ያን ዕዳ ሁሉ ተውሁልህ፤
text.en: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:

text.am: እኔ እንደ ማርሁህ ባልንጀራህ የሆነውን ያን ባሪያ ልትምረው ለአንተስ አይገባህምን? አለው።
text.en: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

text.am: ጌታውም ተቈጣና ዕዳውን ሁሉ እስኪከፍለው ድረስ ለሚሣቅዩት አሳልፎ ሰጠው።
text.en: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

text.am: ከእናንተ እያንዳንዱ ወንድሙን ከልቡ ይቅር ካላለ፥ እንዲሁ ደግሞ የሰማዩ አባቴ ያደርግባችኋል።
text.en: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ይህን ነገር ከፈጸመ በኋላ፥ ከገሊላ ሄዶ ወደ ይሁዳ አውራጃ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ማዶ መጣ።
text.en: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;

text.am: ብዙ ሕዝብም ተከተሉት፥ በዚያም ፈወሳቸው።
text.en: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

text.am: ፈሪሳውያንም ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና ሲፈትኑት። ሰው በሆነው ምክንያት ሁሉ ሚስቱን ሊፈታ ተፈቅዶለታልን? አሉት።
text.en: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

text.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። ፈጣሪ በመጀመሪያ ወንድና ሴት አደረጋቸው፥
text.en: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,

text.am: አለም። ስለዚህ ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል፥ ከሚስቱም ጋር ይተባበራል፥ ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ የሚለውን ቃል አላነበባችሁምን?
text.en: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?

text.am: ስለዚህ አንድ ሥጋ ናቸው እንጂ ወደ ፊት ሁለት አይደሉም። እግዚአብሔር ያጣመረውን እንግዲህ ሰው አይለየው።
text.en: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

text.am: እነርሱም። እንኪያስ ሙሴ የፍችዋን ጽሕፈት ሰጥተው እንዲፈቱአት ስለ ምን አዘዘ? አሉት።
text.en: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

text.am: እርሱም። ሙሴስ ስለ ልባችሁ ጥንካሬ ሚስቶቻችሁን ትፈቱ ዘንድ ፈቀደላችሁ፤ ከጥንት ግን እንዲህ አልነበረም።
text.en: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

text.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ያለ ዝሙት ምክንያት ሚስቱን ፈትቶ ሌላዪቱን የሚያገባ ሁሉ ያመነዝራል፥ የተፈታችውንም የሚያገባ ያመነዝራል አላቸው።
text.en: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። የባልና የሚስት ሥርዓት እንዲህ ከሆነ መጋባት አይጠቅምም አሉት።
text.en: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

text.am: እርሱ ግን። ይህ ነገር ለተሰጣቸው ነው እንጂ ለሁሉ አይደለም፤
text.en: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.

text.am: በእናት ማኅፀን ጃንደረቦች ሆነው የተወለዱ አሉ፥ ሰውም የሰለባቸው ጃንደረቦች አሉ፥ ስለ መንግሥተ ሰማያትም ራሳቸውን የሰለቡ ጃንደረቦች አሉ። ሊቀበለው የሚችል ይቀበለው አላቸው።
text.en: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ እጁን እንዲጭንባቸውና እንዲጸልይ ሕፃናትን ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ገሠጹአቸው።
text.en: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

text.am: ነገር ግን ኢየሱስ። ሕፃናትን ተዉአቸው፥ ወደ እኔም ይመጡ ዘንድ አትከልክሉአቸው፤ መንግሥተ ሰማያት እንደነዚህ ላሉ ናትና አለ፤
text.en: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

text.am: እጁንም ጫነባቸውና ከዚያ ሄደ።
text.en: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

text.am: እነሆም፥ አንድ ሰው ቀርቦ። መምህር ሆይ፥ የዘላለምን ሕይወት እንዳገኝ ምን መልካም ነገር ላድርግ? አለው።
text.en: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

text.am: እርሱም። ስለ መልካም ነገር ለምን ትጠይቀኛለህ? መልካም የሆነ አንድ ነው፤ ወደ ሕይወት መግባት ብትወድ ግን ትእዛዛትን ጠብቅ አለው።
text.en: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

text.am: እርሱም። የትኞችን? አለው። ኢየሱስም። አትግደል፥ አታመንዝር፥ አትስረቅ፥ በሐሰት አትመስክር፥
text.en: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,

text.am: አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፥ ባልንጀራህንም እንደ ራስህ ውደድ አለው።
text.en: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

text.am: ጐበዙም። ይህንማ ሁሉ ከሕፃንነቴ ጀምሬ ጠብቄአለሁ፥ ደግሞስ የሚጐድለኝ ምንድር ነው? አለው።
text.en: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

text.am: ኢየሱስም። ፍጹም ልትሆን ብትወድ፥ ሂድና ያለህን ሸጠህ ለድሆች ስጥ፥ መዝገብም በሰማያት ታገኛለህ፥ መጥተህም ተከተለኝ አለው።
text.en: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.

text.am: ጐበዙም ይህን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ ብዙ ንብረት ነበረውና እያዘነ ሄደ።
text.en: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ለባለጠጋ ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት መግባት ጭንቅ ነው።
text.en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

text.am: ዳግመኛም እላችኋለሁ፥ ባለጠጋ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከሚገባ ግመል በመርፌ ቀዳዳ ቢገባ ይቀላል አለ።
text.en: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሰምተው እጅግ ተገረሙና። እንኪያስ ማን ሊድን ይችላል? አሉ።
text.en: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

text.am: ኢየሱስም እነርሱን ተመልክቶ። ይህ በሰው ዘንድ አይቻልም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ግን ሁሉ ይቻላል አላቸው።
text.en: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጴጥሮስ መልሶ። እነሆ፥ እኛ ሁሉን ትተን ተከተልንህ፤ እንኪያስ ምን እናገኝ ይሆን? አለው።
text.en: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

text.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እናንተስ የተከተላችሁኝ፥ በዳግመኛ ልደት የሰው ልጅ በክብሩ ዙፋን በሚቀመጥበት ጊዜ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ በአሥራ ሁለቱ የእስራኤል ነገድ ስትፈርዱ በአሥራ ሁለት ዙፋን ትቀመጣላችሁ።
text.en: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

text.am: ስለ ስሜም ቤቶችን ወይም ወንድሞችን ወይም እኅቶችን ወይም አባትን ወይም እናትን ወይም ሚስትን ወይም ልጆችን ወይም እርሻን የተወ ሁሉ መቶ እጥፍ ይቀበላል የዘላለምንም ሕይወት ይወርሳል።
text.en: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

text.am: ነገር ግን ብዙዎቹ ፊተኞች ኋለኞች፥ ኋለኞችም ፊተኞች ይሆናሉ።
text.en: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.

text.am: መንግሥተ ሰማያት ለወይኑ አትክልት ሠራተኞችን ሊቀጥር ማልዶ የወጣ ባለቤት ሰውን ትመስላለችና።
text.en: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

text.am: ሠራተኞችንም በቀን አንድ ዲናር ተስማምቶ ወደ ወይኑ አትክልት ሰደዳቸው።
text.en: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

text.am: በሦስት ሰዓትም ወጥቶ ሥራ የፈቱ ሌሎችን በአደባባይ ቆመው አየ፥
text.en: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,

text.am: እነዚያንም። እናንተ ደግሞ ወደ ወይኔ አትክልት ሂዱ የሚገባውንም እሰጣችኋለሁ አላቸው። እነርሱም ሄዱ።
text.en: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

text.am: ደግሞም በስድስትና በዘጠኝ ሰዓት ወጥቶ እንዲሁ አደረገ።
text.en: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.

text.am: በአሥራ አንደኛውም ሰዓት ወጥቶ ሌሎችን ቆመው አገኘና። ሥራ ፈትታችሁ ቀኑን ሁሉ በዚህ ስለ ምን ትቆማላችሁ? አላቸው።
text.en: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

text.am: የሚቀጥረን ስለ አጣን ነው አሉት። እርሱም። እናንተ ደግሞ ወደ ወይኔ አትክልት ሂዱ የሚገባውንም ትቀበላላችሁ አላቸው።
text.en: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.

text.am: በመሸም ጊዜ የወይኑ አትክልት ጌታ አዛዡን። ሠራተኞችን ጥራና ከኋለኞች ጀምረህ እስከ ፊተኞች ድረስ ደመወዝ ስጣቸው አለው።
text.en: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

text.am: በአሥራ አንደኛው ሰዓትም የገቡ መጥተው እያንዳንዳቸው አንድ ዲናር ተቀበሉ።
text.en: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

text.am: ፊተኞችም በመጡ ጊዜ አብዝተው የሚቀበሉ መስሎአቸው ነበር፤ እነርሱም ደግሞ እያንዳንዳቸው አንድ ዲናር ተቀበሉ።
text.en: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.

text.am: ተቀብለውም። እነዚህ ኋለኞች አንድ ሰዓት ሠሩ፥ የቀኑንም ድካምና ትኩሳት ከተሸከምን ከእኛ ጋር አስተካከልሃቸው ብለው በባለቤቱ ላይ አንጐራጐሩ።
text.en: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,

text.am: ተቀብለውም። እነዚህ ኋለኞች አንድ ሰዓት ሠሩ፥ የቀኑንም ድካምና ትኩሳት ከተሸከምን ከእኛ ጋር አስተካከልሃቸው ብለው በባለቤቱ ላይ አንጐራጐሩ።
text.en: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

text.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ ከእነርሱ ለአንዱ እንዲህ አለው። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ አልበደልሁህም በአንድ ዲናር አልተስማማኸኝምን?
text.en: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?

text.am: ድርሻህን ውሰድና ሂድ፤ እኔ ለዚህ ለኋለኛው እንደ አንተ ልሰጠው እወዳለሁ፤ በገንዘቤ የወደድሁትን አደርግ ዘንድ መብት የለኝምን?
text.en: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.

text.am: ወይስ እኔ መልካም ስለ ሆንሁ ዓይንህ ምቀኛ ናትን?
text.en: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?

text.am: እንዲሁ ኋለኞች ፊተኞች፥ ፊተኞችም ኋለኞች ይሆናሉ፤ የተጠሩ ብዙዎች፥ የተመረጡ ግን ጥቂቶች ናቸውና።
text.en: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሊወጣ ሳለ፥ በመንገድ አሥራ ሁለቱን ደቀ መዛሙርት ብቻቸውን ወደ እርሱ አቅርቦ።
text.en: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,

text.am: እነሆ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንወጣለን፥ የሰው ልጅም ለካህናት አለቆችና ለጻፎች ይሰጣል፤ የሞት ፍርድም ይፈርዱበታል፥
text.en: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,

text.am: ሊዘባበቱበትም ሊገርፉትም ሊሰቅሉትም ለአሕዛብ አሳልፈው ይሰጡታል፥ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣል አላቸው።
text.en: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች እናት ከልጆችዋ ጋር እየሰገደችና አንድ ነገር እየለመነች ወደ እርሱ ቀረበች።
text.en: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.

text.am: እርሱም። ምን ትፈልጊያለሽ? አላት። እርስዋም። እነዚህ ሁለቱ ልጆቼ አንዱ በቀኝህ አንዱም በግራህ በመንግሥትህ እንዲቀመጡ እዘዝ አለችው።
text.en: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

text.am: ኢየሱስ ግን መልሶ። የምትለምኑትን አታውቁም። እኔ ልጠጣው ያለውን ጽዋ ልትጠጡ እኔም የምጠመቀውን ጥምቀት ልትጠመቁ ትችላላችሁን? አለ። እንችላለን አሉት።
text.en: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.

text.am: እርሱም። ጽዋዬንስ ትጠጣላችሁ፤ በቀኝና በግራ መቀመጥ ግን ከአባቴ ዘንድ ለተዘጋጀላቸው ነው እንጂ እኔ የምሰጥ አይደለሁም አላቸው።
text.en: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.

text.am: አሥሩም ሰምተው በሁለቱ ወንድማማች ተቈጡ።
text.en: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

text.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው። የአሕዛብ አለቆች እንዲገዙአቸው ታላላቆቹም በላያቸው እንዲሠለጥኑ ታውቃላችሁ።
text.en: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.

text.am: በእናንተስ እንዲህ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ማንም ከእናንተ ታላቅ ሊሆን የሚወድ የእናንተ አገልጋይ ይሁን፥
text.en: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

text.am: ከእናንተም ማንም ፊተኛ ሊሆን የሚወድ የእናንተ ባሪያ ይሁን፤
text.en: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:

text.am: እንዲሁም የሰው ልጅ ሊያገለግል ነፍሱንም ለብዙዎች ቤዛ ሊሰጥ እንጂ እንዲያገለግሉት አልመጣም።
text.en: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

text.am: ከኢያሪኮም ሲወጡ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተከተሉት።
text.en: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

text.am: እነሆም፥ ሁለት ዕውሮች በመንገድ ዳር ተቀምጠው፥ ኢየሱስ እንዲያልፍ በሰሙ ጊዜ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ማረን ብለው ጮኹ።
text.en: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

text.am: ሕዝቡም ዝም እንዲሉ ገሠጹአቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ማረን እያሉ አብዝተው ጮኹ።
text.en: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ቆሞ ጠራቸውና። ምን ላደርግላችሁ ትወዳላችሁ? አለ።
text.en: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?

text.am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ዓይኖቻችን ይከፈቱ ዘንድ አሉት።
text.en: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

text.am: ኢየሱስም አዘነላቸውና ዓይኖቻቸውን ዳሰሰ፥ ወዲያውም አዩና ተከተሉት።
text.en: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.

text.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ቀርበው ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ወደ ቤተ ፋጌ ሲደርሱ፥ ያንጊዜ ኢየሱስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለት ላከ፥
text.en: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,

text.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። በፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ፥ በዚያን ጊዜም የታሰረችን አህያ ውርንጫም ከእርስዋ ጋር ታገኛላችሁ፤ ፈትታችሁ አምጡልኝ።
text.en: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.

text.am: ማንም አንዳች ቢላችሁ። ለጌታ ያስፈልጉታል በሉ፤ ወዲያውም ይሰዳቸዋል።
text.en: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

text.am: ለጽዮን ልጅ። እነሆ፥ ንጉሥሽ የዋህ ሆኖ በአህያ ላይና በአህያይቱ ግልገል በውርንጫይቱ ላይ ተቀምጦ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣል በሉአት ተብሎ በነቢይ የተነገረው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይህ ሆነ።
text.en: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

text.am: ለጽዮን ልጅ። እነሆ፥ ንጉሥሽ የዋህ ሆኖ በአህያ ላይና በአህያይቱ ግልገል በውርንጫይቱ ላይ ተቀምጦ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣል በሉአት ተብሎ በነቢይ የተነገረው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይህ ሆነ።
text.en: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሄደው ኢየሱስ እንዳዘዛቸው አደረጉ፥
text.en: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,

text.am: አህያይቱንና ውርንጫዋንም አመጡለት፥ ልብሳቸውንም በእነርሱ ላይ ጫኑ፥ ተቀመጠባቸውም።
text.en: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.

text.am: ከሕዝቡም እጅግ ብዙዎች ልብሳቸውን በመንገድ ላይ አነጠፉ፥ ሌሎችም ከዛፍ ጫፍ ጫፉን እየቈረጡ በመንገድ ላይ ያነጥፉ ነበር።
text.en: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.

text.am: የሚቀድሙትም ሕዝብ የሚከተሉትም። ሆሣዕና ለዳዊት ልጅ በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ የተባረከ ነው፤ ሆሣዕና በአርያም እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር።
text.en: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

text.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም በገባ ጊዜ መላው ከተማ። ይህ ማን ነው? ብሎ ተናወጠ።
text.en: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

text.am: ሕዝቡም። ይህ ከገሊላ ናዝሬት የመጣ ነቢዩ ኢየሱስ ነው አሉ።
text.en: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ መቅደስ ገባና በመቅደስ የሚሸጡትንና የሚገዙትን ሁሉ አወጣ፥ የገንዘብ ለዋጮችንም ገበታዎች የርግብ ሻጮችንም ወንበሮች ገለበጠና።
text.en: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,

text.am: ቤቴ የጸሎት ቤት ትባላለች ተብሎ ተጽፎአል፥ እናንተ ግን የወንበዶች ዋሻ አደረጋችኋት አላቸው።
text.en: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.

text.am: በመቅደስም ዕውሮችና አንካሶች ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና ፈወሳቸው።
text.en: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

text.am: ነገር ግን የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች ያደረገውን ድንቃ ድንቅ በመቅደስም። ሆሣዕና ለዳዊት ልጅ እያሉ የሚጮኹትን ልጆች ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ተቈጥተው።
text.en: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,

text.am: እነዚህ የሚሉትን አትሰማምን? አሉት። ኢየሱስም። እሰማለሁ፤ ከሕፃናትና ከሚጠቡት አፍ ምስጋናን ለራስህ አዘጋጀህ የሚለውን ቃል ከቶ አላነበባችሁምን? አላቸው።
text.en: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

text.am: ትቶአቸውም ከከተማ ወደ ቢታንያ ወጣ በዚያም አደረ።
text.en: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.

text.am: በማለዳም ወደ ከተማ ሲመለስ ተራበ።
text.en: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.

text.am: በመንገድም አጠገብ በለስ አይቶ ወደ እርስዋ መጣ፤ ከቅጠልም ብቻ በቀር ምንም አላገኘባትምና። ለዘላለሙ ፍሬ አይገኝብሽ አላት። በለሲቱም ያንጊዜውን ደረቀች።
text.en: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ይህን አይተው። በለሲቱ ያንጊዜውን እንዴት ደረቀች? ብለው ተደነቁ።
text.en: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!

text.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እምነት ቢኖራችሁ ባትጠራጠሩም፥ በበለሲቱ እንደ ሆነባት ብቻ አታደርጉም፤ ነገር ግን ይህን ተራራ እንኳ። ተነቅለህ ወደ ባሕር ተወርወር ብትሉት ይሆናል፤
text.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

text.am: አምናችሁም በጸሎት የምትለምኑትን ሁሉ ትቀበላላችሁ አላቸው።
text.en: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

text.am: ወደ መቅደስም ገብቶ ሲያስተምር የካህናት አለቆችና የሕዝብ ሽማግሎች ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና። በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን ታደርጋለህ? ይህንስ ሥልጣን ማን ሰጠህ? አሉት።
text.en: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

text.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እኔ ደግሞ አንዲት ነገር እጠይቃችኋለሁ፤ እናንተም ያችን ብትነግሩኝ እኔ ደግሞ እነዚህን በምን ሥልጣን እንዳደርግ እነግራችኋለሁ፤
text.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

text.am: የዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ከወዴት ነበረች? ከሰማይን ወይስ ከሰው? አላቸው። እነርሱም እርስ በርሳቸው ሲነጋገሩ። ከሰማይ ብንል። እንኪያስ ስለ ምን አላመናችሁበትም? ይለናል፤
text.en: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?

text.am: ከሰው ግን ብንል፥ ዮሐንስን ሁሉም እንደ ነቢይ ያዩታልና ሕዝቡን እንፈራለን አሉ።
text.en: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

text.am: ለኢየሱስም መልሰው። አናውቅም አሉት። እርሱም ደግሞ። እኔም በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን እንዳደርግ አልነግራችሁም አላቸው።
text.en: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

text.am: ነገር ግን ምን ይመስላችኋል? አንድ ሰው ሁለት ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ወደ አንደኛው ቀርቦ። ልጄ ሆይ፥ ዛሬ ሂድና በወይኔ አትክልት ሥራ አለው።
text.en: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.

text.am: እርሱም መልሶ። አልወድም አለ፤ ኋላ ግን ተጸጸተና ሄደ።
text.en: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.

text.am: ወደ ሁለተኛውም ቀርቦ እንዲሁ አለው እርሱም መልሶ። እሺ ጌታዬ አለ፤ ነገር ግን አልሄደም።
text.en: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.

text.am: ከሁለቱ የአባቱን ፈቃድ ያደረገ ማን ነው? ፊተኛው አሉት። ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አላቸው። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ቀራጮችና ጋለሞቶች ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በመግባት ይቀድሙአችኋል።
text.en: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

text.am: ዮሐንስ በጽድቅ መንገድ መጥቶላችሁ ነበርና፥ አላመናችሁበትም፤ ቀራጮችና ጋለሞቶች ግን አመኑበት፤ እናንተም ይህን አይታችሁ ታምኑበት ዘንድ በኋላ ንስሐ አልገባችሁም።
text.en: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.

text.am: ሌላ ምሳሌ ስሙ። የወይን አትክልት የተከለ ባለቤት ሰው ነበረ፤ ቅጥርም ቀጠረለት፥ መጥመቂያም ማሰለት፥ ግንብም ሠራና ለገበሬዎች አከራይቶ ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።
text.en: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:

text.am: የሚያፈራበትም ጊዜ ሲቀርብ፥ ፍሬውን ሊቀበሉ ባሮቹን ወደ ገበሬዎች ላከ።
text.en: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.

text.am: ገበሬዎቹም ባሮቹን ይዘው አንዱን ደበደቡት አንዱንም ገደሉት ሌላውንም ወገሩት።
text.en: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

text.am: ደግሞ ከፊተኞች የሚበዙ ሌሎች ባሮችን ላከ፥ እንዲሁም አደረጉባቸው።
text.en: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.

text.am: በኋላ ግን። ልጄንስ ያፍሩታል ብሎ ልጁን ላከባቸው።
text.en: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.

text.am: ገበሬዎቹ ግን ልጁን ባዩ ጊዜ እርስ በርሳቸው። ወራሹ ይህ ነው፤ ኑ፥ እንግደለውና ርስቱን እናግኝ ተባባሉ።
text.en: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

text.am: ይዘውም ከወይኑ አትክልት አወጡና ገደሉት።
text.en: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.

text.am: እንግዲህ የወይኑ አትክልት ጌታ በሚመጣ ጊዜ በእነዚህ ገበሬዎች ምን ያደርግባቸዋል?
text.en: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?

text.am: እነርሱም። ክፉዎችን በክፉ ያጠፋቸዋል፥ የወይኑንም አትክልት ፍሬውን በየጊዜው ለሚያስረክቡ ለሌሎች ገበሬዎች ይሰጠዋል አሉት።
text.en: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

text.am: ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አላቸው። ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ እርሱ የማዕዘን ራስ ሆነ፤ ይህም ከጌታ ዘንድ ሆነ፥ ለዓይኖቻችንም ድንቅ ነው የሚለውን ከቶ በመጽሐፍ አላነበባችሁምን?
text.en: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

text.am: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከእናንተ ትወሰዳለች ፍሬዋንም ለሚያደርግ ሕዝብ ትሰጣለች።
text.en: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.

text.am: በዚህም ድንጋይ ላይ የሚወድቅ ይቀጠቀጣል፤ ድንጋዩ ግን የሚወድቅበትን ሁሉ ይፈጨዋል።
text.en: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

text.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ፈሪሳውያንም ምሳሌዎቹን ሰምተው ስለ እነርሱ እንደ ተናገረ አስተዋሉ፤
text.en: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.

text.am: ሊይዙትም ሲፈልጉት ሳሉ ሕዝቡ እንደ ነቢይ ስላዩት ፈሩአቸው።
text.en: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.

text.am: ኢየሱስም መለሰ ደግሞም በምሳሌ ነገራቸው እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,

text.am: መንግሥተ ሰማያት ለልጁ ሰርግ ያደረገ ንጉሥን ትመስላለች።
text.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,

text.am: የታደሙትንም ወደ ሰርጉ ይጠሩ ዘንድ ባሮቹን ላከ ሊመጡም አልወደዱም።
text.en: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.

text.am: ደግሞ ሌሎችን ባሮች ልኮ። የታደሙትን። እነሆ፥ ድግሴን አዘጋጀሁ፥ ኮርማዎቼና የሰቡት ከብቶቼ ታርደዋል፥ ሁሉም ተዘጋጅቶአል፤ ወደ ሰርጉ ኑ በሉአቸው አለ።
text.en: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.

text.am: እነርሱ ግን ቸል ብለው አንዱ ወደ እርሻው፥ ሌላውም ወደ ንግዱ ሄደ፤
text.en: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

text.am: የቀሩትም ባሮቹን ይዘው አንገላቱአቸው ገደሉአቸውም።
text.en: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.

text.am: ንጉሡም ተቈጣ፥ ጭፍሮቹንም ልኮ እነዚያን ገዳዮች አጠፋ፤ ከተማቸውንም አቃጠለ።
text.en: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ባሮቹን። ሰርጉስ ተዘጋጅቶአል፥ ነገር ግን የታደሙት የማይገባቸው ሆኑ፤
text.en: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.

text.am: እንግዲህ ወደ መንገድ መተላለፊያ ሄዳችሁ ያገኛችሁትን ሁሉ ወደ ሰርጉ ጥሩ አለ።
text.en: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.

text.am: እነዚያም ባሮች ወደ መንገድ ወጥተው ያገኙትን ሁሉ ክፉዎችንም በጎዎችንም ሰበሰቡ፤ የሰርጉንም ቤት ተቀማጮች ሞሉት።
text.en: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.

text.am: ንጉሡም የተቀመጡትን ለማየት በገባ ጊዜ በዚያ የሰርግ ልብስ ያለበሰ አንድ ሰው አየና። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥
text.en: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:

text.am: የሰርግ ልብስ ሳትለብስ እንዴት ወደዚህ ገባህ? አለው እርሱም ዝም አለ።
text.en: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ንጉሡ አገልጋዮቹን። እጁንና እግሩን አስራችሁ በውጭ ወዳለው ጨለማ አውጡት፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል አለ።
text.en: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

text.am: የተጠሩ ብዙዎች፥ የተመረጡ ግን ጥቂቶች ናቸውና።
text.en: For many are called, but few are chosen.

text.am: ስለዚህ ፈሪሳውያን ሄዱና እንዴት አድርገው በነገር እንዲያጠምዱት ተማከሩ።
text.en: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.

text.am: ደቀ መዛሙርታቸውንም ከሄሮድስ ወገን ጋር ላኩበት፥ እነርሱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ እውነተኛ እንደ ሆንህ በእውነትም የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ እንድታስተምር እናውቃለን፥ ለማንምም አታደላም፥ የሰውን ፊት አትመለከትምና፤
text.en: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.

text.am: እንግዲህ ምን ይመስልሃል? ንገረን ለቄሣር ግብር መስጠት ተፈቅዶአልን ወይስ አልተፈቀደም? አሉት።
text.en: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?

text.am: ኢየሱስም ክፋታቸውን አውቆ። እናንተ ግብዞች፥ ስለ ምን ትፈትኑኛላችሁ?
text.en: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?

text.am: የግብሩን ብር አሳዩኝ አለ። እነርሱም ዲናር አመጡለት።
text.en: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.

text.am: እርሱም። ይህች መልክ ጽሕፈቲቱስ የማን ናት? አላቸው።
text.en: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?

text.am: የቄሣር ነው አሉት። በዚያን ጊዜ። እንኪያስ የቄሣርን ለቄሣር የእግዚአብሔርንም ለእግዚአብሔር አስረክቡ አላቸው።
text.en: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.

text.am: ይህንም ሰምተው ተደነቁ፥ ትተውትም ሄዱ።
text.en: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.

text.am: በዚያን ቀን። ትንሣኤ ሙታን የለም የሚሉ ሰዱቃውያን ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፥
text.en: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,

text.am: እንዲህም ብለው ጠየቁት። መምህር ሆይ፥ ሙሴ አንድ ሰው ልጅ ሳይወልድ ሲሞት ወንድሙ ሚስቱን አግብቶ ለወንድሙ ዘር ይተካ አለ።
text.en: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

text.am: ሰባት ወንድማማች በእኛ ዘንድ ነበሩ፤ ፊተኛውም ሚስት አግብቶ ሞተ፥ ዘርም ስለሌለው ሚስቱን ለወንድሙ ተወለት፤
text.en: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:

text.am: እንዲሁ ደግሞ ሁለተኛው ሦስተኛውም፥ እስከ ሰባተኛው ድረስ።
text.en: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.

text.am: ከሁሉም በኋላ ሴቲቱ ሞተች።
text.en: And last of all the woman died also.

text.am: ሁሉ አግብተዋታልና በትንሣኤ ቀንስ፥ ከሰባቱ ለማናቸው ሚስት ትሆናለች?
text.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

text.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። መጻሕፍትንና የእግዚአብሔርን ኃይል አታውቁምና ትስታላችሁ።
text.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

text.am: በትንሣኤስ እንደ እግዚአብሔር መላእክት በሰማይ ይሆናሉ እንጂ አያገቡም አይጋቡምም።
text.en: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.

text.am: ስለ ትንሣኤ ሙታን ግን። እኔ የአብርሃም አምላክ፥ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ ነኝ የሚል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ እናንተ የተባለውን አላነበባችሁምን? የሕያዋን አምላክ ነው እንጂ የሙታን አይደለም።
text.en: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,

text.am: ስለ ትንሣኤ ሙታን ግን። እኔ የአብርሃም አምላክ፥ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ ነኝ የሚል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ እናንተ የተባለውን አላነበባችሁምን? የሕያዋን አምላክ ነው እንጂ የሙታን አይደለም።
text.en: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

text.am: ሕዝቡም ይህን ሰምተው በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ።
text.en: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.

text.am: ፈሪሳውያንም ሰዱቃውያንን ዝም እንዳሰኛቸው በሰሙ ጊዜ አብረው ተሰበሰቡ።
text.en: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.

text.am: ከእነርሱም አንድ ሕግ አዋቂ ሊፈትነው።
text.en: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,

text.am: መምህር ሆይ፥ ከሕግ ማናቸይቱ ትእዛዝ ታላቅ ናት? ብሎ ጠየቀው።
text.en: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?

text.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አለው። ጌታ አምላክህን በፍጹም ልብህ በፍጹም ነፍስህም በፍጹም አሳብህም ውደድ።
text.en: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

text.am: ታላቂቱና ፊተኛይቱ ትእዛዝ ይህች ናት።
text.en: This is the first and great commandment.

text.am: ሁለተኛይቱም ይህችን ትመስላለች፥ እርስዋም። ባልንጀራህን እንደ ነፍስህ ውደድ የምትለው ናት።
text.en: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

text.am: በእነዚህ በሁለቱ ትእዛዛት ሕጉም ሁሉ ነቢያትም ተሰቅለዋል።
text.en: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

text.am: ፈሪሳውያንም ተሰብስበው ሳሉ፥ ኢየሱስ። ስለ ክርስቶስ ምን ይመስላችኋል? የማንስ ልጅ ነው? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው። የዳዊት ልጅ ነው አሉት።
text.en: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

text.am: ፈሪሳውያንም ተሰብስበው ሳሉ፥ ኢየሱስ። ስለ ክርስቶስ ምን ይመስላችኋል? የማንስ ልጅ ነው? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው። የዳዊት ልጅ ነው አሉት።
text.en: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.

text.am: እርሱም። እንኪያስ ዳዊት። ጌታ ጌታዬን። ጠላቶችህን የእግርህ መረገጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ አለው ሲል እንዴት በመንፈስ ጌታ ብሎ ይጠራዋል?
text.en: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,

text.am: እርሱም። እንኪያስ ዳዊት። ጌታ ጌታዬን። ጠላቶችህን የእግርህ መረገጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ አለው ሲል እንዴት በመንፈስ ጌታ ብሎ ይጠራዋል?
text.en: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?

text.am: ዳዊትስ ጌታ ብሎ ከጠራው፥ እንዴት ልጁ ይሆናል? አላቸው።
text.en: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

text.am: አንድም ቃል ስንኳ ይመልስለት ዘንድ የተቻለው የለም፥ ከዚያ ቀንም ጀምሮ ወደ ፊት ማንም ሊጠይቀው አልደፈረም።
text.en: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ ለሕዝቡና ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንዲህ ብሎ ነገራቸው።
text.en: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,

text.am: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን በሙሴ ወንበር ተቀምጠዋል።
text.en: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:

text.am: ስለዚህ ያዘዙአችሁን ሁሉ አድርጉ ጠብቁትም፥ ነገር ግን እየተናገሩ አያደርጉትምና እንደ ሥራቸው አታድርጉ።
text.en: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

text.am: ከባድና አስቸጋሪ ሸክም ተብትበው በሰው ትከሻ ይጭናሉ፥ እነርሱ ግን በጣታቸው ስንኳ ሊነኩት አይወዱም።
text.en: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.

text.am: ለሰውም እንዲታዩ ሥራቸውን ሁሉ ያደርጋሉ፤ ስለዚህ አሽንክታባቸውን ያሰፋሉ ዘርፉንም ያስረዝማሉ፥
text.en: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

text.am: በምሳም የከበሬታ ስፍራ፥ በምኵራብም የከበሬታ ወንበር፥
text.en: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

text.am: በገበያም ሰላምታና። መምህር ሆይ መምህር ሆይ ተብለው እንዲጠሩ ይወዳሉ።
text.en: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

text.am: እናንተ ግን። መምህር ተብላችሁ አትጠሩ፤ መምህራችሁ አንድ ስለ ሆነ እናንተም ሁላችሁ ወንድማማች ናችሁ።
text.en: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.

text.am: አባታችሁ አንዱ እርሱም የሰማዩ ነውና በምድር ላይ ማንንም። አባት ብላችሁ አትጥሩ።
text.en: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

text.am: ሊቃችሁ አንድ እርሱም ክርስቶስ ነውና። ሊቃውንት ተብላችሁ አትጠሩ።
text.en: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.

text.am: ከእናንተም የሚበልጠው አገልጋያችሁ ይሆናል።
text.en: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

text.am: ራሱን ከፍ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ይዋረዳል፥ ራሱንም የሚያዋርድ ሁሉ ከፍ ይላል።
text.en: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

text.am: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ መንግሥተ ሰማያትን በሰው ፊት ስለምትዘጉ፥ ወዮላችሁ እናንተ አትገቡም የሚገቡትንም እንዳይገቡ ትከለክላላችሁ።
text.en: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.

text.am: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ በጸሎት ርዝመት እያመካኛችሁ የመበለቶችን ቤት ስለምትበሉ፥ ወዮላችሁ፤ ስለዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ትቀበላላችሁ።
text.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

text.am: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ አንድ ሰው ልታሳምኑ በባሕርና በደረቅ ስለምትዞሩ፥ በሆነም ጊዜ ከእናንተ ይልቅ ሁለት እጥፍ የባሰ የገሃነም ልጅ ስለምታደርጉት፥ ወዮላችሁ።
text.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

text.am: እናንተ። ማንም በቤተ መቅደስ የሚምል ምንም የለበትም፤ ማንም በቤተ መቅደስ ወርቅ የሚምል ግን በመሐላው ይያዛል የምትሉ፥ ዕውሮች መሪዎች፥ ወዮላችሁ።
text.en: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

text.am: እናንተ ደንቆሮዎችና ዕውሮች፥ ማናቸው ይበልጣል? ወርቁ ነውን? ወይስ ወርቁን የቀደሰው ቤተ መቅደስ?
text.en: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

text.am: ደግማችሁም። ማንም በመሠዊያው የሚምል ምንም የለበትም፤ ማንም በላዩ ባለው መባ የሚምል ግን በመሐላው ይያዛል ትላላችሁ።
text.en: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

text.am: እናንተ ደንቆሮዎችና ዕውሮች፥ ማናቸው ይበልጣል? መባው ነውን? ወይስ መባውን የሚቀድሰው መሠዊያው?
text.en: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

text.am: እንግዲህ በመሠዊያው የሚምለው በእርሱና በእርሱ ላይ ባለው ሁሉ ይምላል፤
text.en: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

text.am: በቤተ መቅደስም የሚምለው በእርሱና በእርሱ በሚኖረው ይምላል፤
text.en: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

text.am: በሰማይም የሚምለው በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋንና በእርሱ ላይ በተቀመጠው ይምላል።
text.en: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

text.am: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ ከአዝሙድና ከእንስላል ከከሙንም አሥራት ስለምታወጡ፥ ፍርድንና ምሕረትን ታማኝነትንም፥ በሕግ ያለውን ዋና ነገር ስለምትተዉ፥ ወዮላችሁ፤ ሌላውን ሳትተዉ ይህን ልታደርጉ ይገባችሁ ነበር።
text.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

text.am: እናንተ ዕውሮች መሪዎች፥ ትንኝን የምታጠሩ ግመልንም የምትውጡ።
text.en: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

text.am: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ በውስጡ ቅሚያና ስስት ሞልቶ ሳለ የጽዋውንና የወጭቱን ውጭ ስለምታጠሩ፥ ወዮላችሁ።
text.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
